items.quote: sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes
items.claim: The people must sanctify themselves and wash their clothes today and tomorrow in preparation

items.quote: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai
items.claim: On the third day, the LORD will appear visibly to all the people at Mount Sinai
items.mechanism: in the sight of all the people
